set.body:
Reference neighborhoods and original-observation certification — 2026-10-08

PHRF-33 remains open/not admitted. Exploratory fixed-shape coverage under two predeclared eight-reference banks is poor even when all eight references are compared offline. N=30 corners cover 0/64 original-amplitude targets at both 48/96 seconds; quarters cover 4/64 and 11/64. N=300 corners cover 0/32; quarters cover 0/32 and 2/32. The target remains relative amplitude L2 <=1e-3. Exact prepared-vs-original counts improve from 30/64 to 58/64 (N=30) and 16/32 to 28/32 (N=300) when support grows. Basis/representation error is recorded separately from corrected-readout error and analytic tail truncation. All eight coverage ScenarioResults are Fail. Offline best-of-eight is not a legal <=2-reference router; no decoder or independent scientific confirmation runs in this experiment.

At N=1200, 48-second preparation succeeds (reported shared reference bytes 204786040; retained preparation doubles 9116727). The 96-second attempt needs 24022669 retained values and refuses the unchanged 16000000 cap. These are scoped storage receipts, not engine peak memory. No new complete B0 throughput result exists; previous incomplete attempts remain the evidence. The frozen <=8 references, <=2 evaluated per voxel, one correction, certification and 256 MiB/120-second caps are unchanged. A 120-second undershoot peak is permitted by the default chart despite 48-second support; simply extending support does not fit the current stress storage budget.

Next: resolve domain/reference coverage before another full sweep. If the full chart is essential, revised work budgets or a different representation need an explicit contract. Finite-state work remains deferred; no exact fallback or 901-request search is silently admitted.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-neighborhoods-20261007/README.md on local work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007, source base 101c5ab6; hashes verified. Gale generic outward exponential and validated reference-system bounds are in 62c0aeb3374557874a17f870c9ae05e3290c21cf (https://github.com/canardlapin/gale/pull/24, merged); ScalaFIM pins that topic revision without unrelated optimizer additions. Full fit tests pass: 707 JVM / 649 Scala.js; new observation/neighborhood laws, N=1200 integration, all 80 recovery reference cases with unchanged tolerances, and targeted comparison tests pass on both platforms. scalafimCompileAll passes without compiler warnings. Numerical/scientific/production qualification remain distinct. No ScalaFIM merge or publication.

---

Prior evidence and acceptance history:

Residual admission and envelope-gradient follow-through — 2026-10-07

PHRF-33 remains open/not admitted. Blocked N=1200 preparation, repaired decoding and public output continue to pass the portable low-noise integration scenario. The penalized search now uses a domain envelope-gradient contraction with one value reference: 3 band solves / 13 RHS per B0 call, versus the previous first-order 9/43 and full-jet 21/103. Nine starts, 901-request diagnostic budget, priors and terminal full-jet admission remain unchanged; optional provenance is bounded-multistart/v3. Five alternating paired 64-call probes show 6.97x JVM and 5.44x FastOpt Scala.js ratios against full jets, not against the previous first-order path and not end-to-end workload speedups. Gale pin remains 0a981febc163e539b019aa9379935e21d8987a20.

The 120-second bounded B0 attempt reaches 384/100000 in 126.125s (52 decoder accepted, 266 Boundary, 66 CurvatureNotPositive); all 52 accepted shapes fail the explicit 1e-8 prepared residual gate. N=1200 reaches 18/10000 in 136.570s, all Boundary. No complete block is delivered or coefficient output emitted before cancellation. Attempted numerical work is retained. Preparation is 1.549s / 21.938s. Other JVM activity and uncontrolled long-lived sbt state preclude an end-to-end before/after speed claim. Whole-process heap samples are not engine peak; the source-only shared-plus-eight-search-reference scenario falls to 224.75 MiB, while eight full terminal references still reach 321.04 MiB before excluded scratch/blocks/metadata.

The 192-second N=1200 attempt refuses kernel-compiler training work before trial preparation. Finite observation bounds remain loose and exclude the original pipeline. Complete original-family certification, broader scientific qualification and full B0/stress throughput/live-memory gates are still unmet. FiniteState remains deferred; the repaired 901-request diagnostic is not a silent replacement of the frozen baseline.

Validation: full fit 706 JVM / 648 Scala.js tests pass. All 80 recovery reference cases preserve the prior energy/shape/admission tolerances on both platforms; no bitwise trajectory identity is claimed. The six targeted law suites pass on both platforms (18 JS tests; JVM runs include final two-test horizon suite). Comparison: 466 JVM passed / 10 skipped, 17 targeted Scala.js tests passed. Compiler warning-clean; existing multiple-main discovery message only. No hosted CI, merge or publication. Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-readout-bounds-20261007/README.md on local work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007, base e1d67dfb; source/artifact hashes verified. Scientific and epic qualification remain open.

---

Prior evidence and acceptance history:

Qualification attempt — 2026-10-07 (local work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007)

PHRF-33 remains open and not admitted. Combined blocked N=1200 preparation and repaired multistart: the high-noise four-voxel control returns four Boundary refusals without budget exits; the lower-noise control emits 4/4 with prepared residual <4.57e-12. A portable one-voxel stress integration scenario passes JVM and JS.

The original-equation/scientific audit finds material distant-reference correction and HRF-tail errors; certification remains unavailable. Full declared B0/stress requests are now attempted with explicit 120-second cancellation limits, retaining partial attempted counters and distinguishing discarded-block work from emitted output. Final repaired B0 reaches only 404/100000 attempts in 122.274 seconds; N=1200 reaches 32/10000 in 147.754 seconds. No complete certified throughput or measured engine-memory result is claimed.

Fixed production DatasetAcquisitionDomain's O(V^2) reverse-map setup by reusing one ordinal array; fixed diagnostic reader allocations. B0 setup is now under two seconds in the final repeats. Finite-state remains deferred: no complete original-family-qualified B0 decision, no silent replacement of the frozen baseline by the 901-request diagnostic budget. Next work is bounded observation/reference error admission, broader scientific evidence, then complete resource qualification.

Final gates: dataset 76 JVM / 62 JS; targeted workflows 8 JVM / 8 JS; compiler warning-clean. Existing main-discovery warning only. No hosted CI, publication or epic closure. Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-qualification-20261007/README.md and certification-audit.md; 41 source/artifact hashes verified.

---

Retained prior scope and acceptance

Bounded N=1200 trial preparation — 2026-10-07

Completed the next PHRF-33 prerequisite on work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007, based on 80b43d69. TrialDesignLowering.Blocked(size), through ProfileDecodePolicy.trialPreparation, lowers/whitens complete time columns in bounded trial blocks and retains packed temporal support. The existing dense API and its convolution caps remain. Source axes now bind a sealed TrialBasisDesign; blocked sources retain schedule metadata and zero convolved source data. Mixed runs/TRs, durations, caller ordering, partial blocks and full AR/MA tails are preserved. A default 16-million-entry preparation-owned storage cap refuses excess packed/Gram storage before allocation; it is not a total or peak engine-memory cap. Public provenance binds nondefault preparation policy, and receipts report block sizes and actual retained source values. No Gale change or scientific admission/tolerance change.

The previously refused T=600,N=1200,C=3,F=6,rank=10,AR(1)=0.3 random stress geometry now completes public preparation on both JVM and Scala.js, including the eight-node bank. Both platforms report 38 blocks, at most 192000 convolved values/block, bandwidth 127, 9116727 preparation-owned numeric entries, zero dense source values and a scoped preparation-plus-bank estimate of 204786040 bytes (about 195.3 MiB). The dense 7200000-cell shape still refuses its 4000004 cap. Single-run public preparation takes 2.538s JVM and 13.667s Scala.js FastOpt; these are diagnostics, not controlled speedups, peak memory or complete workload throughput.

The existing DecodedTrialCheckpoint runner supports an optional final trial block size, contracts fixture design blocks without a T*N*m source, and persists structured preparation counts. A four-voxel N=1200 baseline-budget public diagnostic now reaches execution; all refusals remain in its denominator. Original-family certification still refuses. See the packet for exact statuses and counts; a baseline-budget diagnostic is not the repaired multistart scientific qualification campaign.

Validation: full design and fit suites pass on JVM and JS; final packed/dense/public workflow laws pass on both; the 16-test recovery workflow passes on both including all 80 reference cells, boundary refusals and existing native-ML/QR controls. Warning-clean scalafimCompileAll and fitBenchJVM/compile pass. Tests cover dense/blocked geometry, derivatives, public exact/corrected trial and nuisance outputs, metadata binding, overflow/storage refusal and unchanged fixture Float32 results. Two development failures were corrected and their logs retained. No hosted ScalaFIM CI run is claimed.

Evidence and verifier: docs/verification/phrf-bounded-preparation-20261007/README.md. PHRF-33 and epic remain OPEN/NOT ADMITTED. The N=1200 dense-lowering setup blocker is removed; PHRF-11 original-equation certification, broader recovery/scientific admission and complete B0/stress timing/live-memory gates remain. The shared-array estimate alone leaves little room for excluded worker/reference-build scratch and does not establish the 256 MiB gate. No finite-state activation or acceptance criterion changed.

---

Prior evidence and acceptance history:

First-order search cost reduction — 2026-10-07

Completed the next bounded PHRF-33 performance pass on work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007, based on 932acd61. Penalized trial search now requests a typed first-order oracle (four components in Cascade34 instead of ten). Full jets remain mandatory at terminal admission. Nine starts, all evaluation caps, prior/scaling/tie policy and terminal tolerances remain unchanged. The optional policy identity is bounded-multistart/v2. Native ML and other backends without the capability retain full-jet search. Failed first-order requests are charged; public and backend receipts distinguish them from full jets without bypassing maxJets.

The fresh JVM receipt retains all 80 terminal results and all 720 trajectories exactly, including evaluation counts, stop reasons, coordinates, energies and Hessians. All 60 emitted public outputs/checksums and 20 refusals are unchanged. 32,256 search calls are now first order and 80 full jets remain. Independent dense/SciPy/QR checks still pass. Four additional generating HRF shapes pass derivative parity and finite differences; these do not establish broad search recovery or scientific calibration.

Five alternating, fixed 256-call repetitions after per-mode warmup show 3.58x JVM and 3.36x FullOpt oracle speedups with identical within-platform checksums. Banded work drops from 21 solves/103 RHS to 9/43 per call. The full 80-cell uninstrumented JVM diagnostic takes 125.382s versus 399.106s previously (3.18x), with unchanged work-request counts. FullOpt ratio-0.1 takes 59.625s versus 156.107s previously. These are diagnostic same-host measurements with uncontrolled other activity, not frozen B0 throughput or peak-memory admission.

Both FullOpt CPU profiles and paired timings are retained. After first-order reduction, weighted band assembly is about 37% of the sampled self time; the band-product/reference-solve assembly group is about 13%. No additional Gale API/pin change is included. Current merged provider remains 0a981febc163e539b019aa9379935e21d8987a20. The next performance investigation should reduce reference work (including a separately derived envelope-gradient candidate) and validate a cheaper search policy on broader recovery cohorts before reducing budgets. Generic algebra remains Gale-owned.

Validation: warning-clean scalafimCompileAll; 697 JVM/640 JS fit tests; 22 JVM public recovery/workflow tests; 7 JS FullOpt refinement and 15 JS FastOpt other public recovery/workflow tests; fixed-call probe on both platforms. The FullOpt combined command passed its tests but failed while resetting the stage after sbt heap thrashing. Only the verified worktree server was stopped; all final gates and explicit FastOpt restoration completed on a fresh server. Both interrupted logs are retained. Temporary profiling test source is archived and removed. No hosted ScalaFIM CI run is claimed.

Evidence and verifier: docs/verification/phrf-gradient-20261007/README.md. Source/artifact hashes bind the complete packet. PHRF-33/epic remain OPEN/NOT ADMITTED. Bounded N=1200 preparation, PHRF-11 original-equation certification, complete B0/stress measurement and scientific calibration remain prerequisites. No acceptance criterion or finite-state activation changes.

---

Prior evidence and acceptance history:

Bounded refinement repair — 2026-10-07

Both search counterexamples retained by the preceding recovery experiment are repaired. The opt-in DecodeInitialization.BoundedMultistart uses nine independent bounded projected-BFGS searches from Gale, then the ordinary full-jet Newton terminal checks. Gale PR #21 is merged and pinned at 0a981febc163e539b019aa9379935e21d8987a20. Default BankNode/ChartCenterProbe behavior and existing terminal tolerances are unchanged. New-mode provenance is bounded-multistart/v1 within decode-budget/v2. All oracle calls, failures and attempted voxels are charged and every trajectory stop/last point is retained.

Against the unchanged 80-cell matched dense/SciPy/QR reference, all energies agree within 1e-9 scaled error. All 60 reference interior fits emit actual public outputs and all 20 boundary-preferred fits remain refused. Ratio 0.1 voxel 10 reaches the correct interior minimum; ratio 1 voxel 3 selects the better boundary solution and refuses rather than emitting the worse local minimum. The full 60 outputs consume 18,000 Float32 values. One generating HRF and condition-constant trial amplitudes mean this is prepared-basis computational evidence, not original-family, random-effects or general scientific calibration.

Cost is explicitly diagnostic: 16 Newton steps, 901 jets, 40 exact evaluations, 30 attempts per step, 1e-6 raw stationarity tolerance; nine starts each receive at most 90 evaluations. Final 80-cell public execution took 399.106 seconds and charged 32336 full jets on Mac14,12 (10 CPUs/32 GiB), single worker, with no controlled warmup/repetition/peak-memory campaign. This is not the historical reference host or the frozen B0 admission budget. Full Hessians are currently computed even during value/gradient search. No full-workload throughput pass or measured frozen B0 miss is asserted.

Validation on the hosted merged provider, without local override: scalafimCompileAll; AR 155 JVM/153 JS; fit 694 JVM/637 JS; 21 public recovery/workflow tests per platform. Gale core 804 JVM/792 JS and upstream CI passed. The optional Bugbot scan was unavailable for its usage limit; repository security and approval checks passed. Packet source/artifact hashes, all 80 attempts, 720 searches, work quotas and actual output counters verify.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-refinement-20261007/README.md, branch work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007 based on 95d2c66b; exact source hashes in manifest.json. Primary cohort/evidence/v2 documents link the new status. The original recovery/checkpoint packets remain historical, unchanged.

Next bounded work: implement and measure a charged value/gradient-only oracle plus a staged search budget against retained counterexamples and broader generating-shape cohorts. Preserve terminal admission and honest work/refusals. Separately complete bounded N=1200 lowering and PHRF-11 original-equation evidence; then run the actual full B0/stress and scientific gates. PHRF-33 and the epic remain OPEN/NOT ADMITTED; PHRF-14/15/16 remain open and optional finite-state work deferred. No acceptance criterion is relaxed.

Scala.js slowdown investigation: uninstrumented matched test batches were about 4.2x JVM. Two live 20-second V8 samples attribute roughly 64-66% of self time to ScalaFIM derivative-band assembly and band-by-derivative-solution products, about 6.5-6.7% to Gale banded solves, and 0.1-0.2% to GC. A synthetic B0-dimension replay of the emitted fastopt kernels preserves every output exactly; direct typed arrays give a 2.68x band-product speedup and batching nine RHS gives 3.22x, versus only 1.09x for band assembly. This suggests a generic validated packed symmetric-band block operation upstream in Gale plus first-order PHRF search policy downstream. It is a kernel experiment, not a measured fit speedup. See JS-PROFILE.md for the fullOpt comparison, raw profiles and limitations. The exhaustive suite is retained; the weekly calibration job allowance rises from 30 to 60 minutes. No scientific performance budget changes.

FullOpt diagnosis: the same 16 ratio-0.1 assertions pass in 156.107s, versus 388.818s fastopt and 89.957s JVM. Thus fullOpt is 2.49x faster than the default JS test bundle in this diagnostic; the remaining gap is 1.74x JVM. This is one batch, without normalized oracle counts or repetitions. Use fullOpt for performance work and reprofile that bundle before deciding the Gale API. The temporary single-case selector is archived; the complete suite is restored byte-for-byte and recompiled, with FastOptStage restored. Initial unsupported CLI filter attempts ran no numerical test.

---

Previous recovery/checkpoint history and retained acceptance:

Recovery experiment and partial repair — 2026-10-07

Independent nine-start dense/QR reference on 16 matched B0 voxels at noise ratios 0, 0.1, 0.5, 1, 2 proves noiseless recovery and separates search defects from weak-signal behavior. Source/evidence: docs/verification/phrf-recovery-20261007/README.md, branch work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007 based on ff4dd39f. All 80 reference energies agree with the portable banded objective. This is prepared-basis, condition-constant trial signal evidence, not original-family or random-effects calibration.

Retained opt-in DecodeInitialization.ChartCenterProbe charges one full jet/candidate when available and better under the data-plus-prior criterion. Default BankNode and default numerical budgets remain unchanged; provenance is explicitly decode-budget/v2 for both policies. With the same diagnostic 16-step/20-jet/40-exact/12-attempt budget and 1e-6 stationarity tolerance, eight-node bank-only accepts 0/16 at every noise level; center probe accepts 16,15,15,8,2. The independent reference has 16,16,15,10,3 interior stationary positive-curvature solutions and 0,0,1,6,13 boundary-preferred solutions. These budgets are not an accepted frozen B0 amendment.

Remaining concrete search failures: ratio 0.1 voxel 10 refuses curvature despite an interior reference solution (energy 1.8835732663 vs 1.7900486410). Ratio 1 voxel 3 is locally Accepted at a worse minimum than the boundary reference (3.9292657532 vs 3.9263841234; shape difference 0.3364 chart widths). Local Accepted does not establish best-solution selection. More bank nodes, nine interior probes and curvature-guarded backtracking did not resolve the strong-signal counterexample; the latter two were removed from production and archived as rejected experiments.

Validation: full fitJVM 689/689, full fitJS 632/632; 15 recovery/public-readout/workflow tests on each platform; packet verifies 53 source/artifact hashes, exact archived inputs and all 80 reference/candidate records. All 16 noiseless public outputs are off-node and consumed with Float32 conversion in the shared test. Receipts retain refused attempts and charged work. Small diagnostic execution times are not qualifying throughput.

Next bounded work: repair refinement and selection against the two concrete counterexamples while preserving budgets/terminal semantics (generic optimization belongs in Gale); specify weak/boundary scientific behavior; complete bounded N=1200 lowering and PHRF-11 original-equation evidence; only then execute full B0/stress performance gates and make the PHRF-33 activation/engineering decision. PHRF-33 remains OPEN/NOT ADMITTED. PHRF-14/15/16 remain open; finite-state work remains deferred. No acceptance criterion is relaxed.

---

Previous checkpoint and retained acceptance:

Current measured assessment — 2026-10-07

Public decoded diagnostic implemented and tested on JVM and JS, with independent augmented-QR output oracle and attempted/refused denominator. Source/receipts: docs/verification/phrf-checkpoint-20261007/README.md, branch work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007 based on 9ba2c57f (hosted Gale d03eb99b). PHRF-33 remains NOT ADMITTED and open; no full B0/performance/scientific pass or finite-state activation.

Measured blockers: dense basis compiler refuses 2,727,270 training cells above 2,000,000. Explicit BlockedPartial(96) admits unchanged rank 10/tolerance/domain. Under frozen eight-node bank/two-jet baseline, exact and corrected modes emit 0/256: 93 budget and 163 curvature refusals. Expanded six-step/eight-jet budget still emits 0/256; an explicit 27-node bank plus that budget emits 5/256. N=1,200 lowering refuses 7,200,000 convolved-term cells above 4,000,004. Original-equation evidence still refuses before reads. Current small samples are diagnostic, not throughput qualification; phase timing/memory/full denominators remain incomplete.

Next bounded work: resolve shape initialization/refinement admission against a dense same-model oracle before throughput tuning, preserve terminal/refusal semantics; make stress-case lowering bounded; integrate PHRF-11 original-equation evidence; then run full frozen checkpoint and make the activation/engineering decision. Old discarded-jet/fixed-truth component timings no longer say the complete gate passed. Do not treat a larger grid/budget as an accepted freeze change.

Earlier assessment and retained acceptance:

Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: Current decoded native ML/readout path is available and now charges stable-energy work and worker scratch. No complete frozen B0 profile/readout/certification checkpoint was run during consolidation; old discarded-jet/fixed-truth timings remain components.

Fresh context: Yes: complete workload decision.

Next action: Measure the actual current public path and all attempted work on the unchanged B0/stress schedule. Make a documented pass or activation/engineering decision; do not activate finite-state from an open ticket or old microbenchmark.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-pilot-integration-20261004.md; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md; original PHRF-33 workload criteria.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Owner: fit/profile integration benchmark and qualification receipt. Required P1 successor for the incomplete PHRF-07 checkpoint. Depends on PHRF-11 public decoded readout, PHRF-21 requalified shared condition/decoder contract, and PHRF-32 trial laws; PHRF-29 is reached through PHRF-11. This checkpoint precedes the full PHRF-14/15 qualification, so it cannot depend on those later results.

Problem:
TrialBandedBenchmark.scala:240 computes two jets then discards them. CompletePrepared reads the best bank node; CompleteExact reads the fixed generating coordinates from setup. ShapeDecoder, continuous refinement and final equation/basis/readout certification are absent. Existing 30.422/48.198-second timings remain valid component receipts, but not a complete profile+readout+certification pass.

Acceptance:
1. Define an executable measurement through the actual public PHRF-29/11 path: response acquisition/whitening/projection, declared criterion/prior scan, bounded continuous decoding, verified terminal curvature/admission, readout at THAT returned theta, equation/approximation certification, normalization/query/Float32 conversion and sink delivery. Include every attempted voxel, refusal and fallback. No hard-coded truth coordinates or discarded jets may stand in for selection.
2. Preserve frozen B0: T=600,N=300,C=3,F=6,V=100000,d=3, default Cascade34 family/chart/horizon and admitted basis, lambda=1, shared AR(1)=0.3, seeded dense schedule, eight-factor bank/eight-worker/256-block declared configuration and 120MB Float32 trial-output workload. Report the exact existing reference-host specification and revisions. Do not change the domain/rank/error tolerance to satisfy speed. Any necessary budget/configuration change is an explicit old/new decision with numerical consequences, not silent drift.
3. Report all node/continuous/value/jet/factor/solve/RHS counts, rejected attempts, terminal verification and approximate/exact-readout work. TrialBanded jetAt/energyAt currently build fresh factors off-node; measure that cost or implement an explicitly admitted bounded alternative before claiming the original budget. One amplitude correction and certification work remain explicit. Avoid hidden per-voxel covariance preparation.
4. Fill fixed-shape, one-reference, complete prepared/corrected and opt-in exact decoded readout cells on identical data/output work. Use <=120s complete B0 and <=256MiB engine live memory, plus <=12x one-reference and <=24x two-reference ratios to the appropriate exact fixed-shape denominator. Timing phases must expose input generation/acquisition, whitening, geometry/certificate preparation, projection, selection, readout and IO separately and in complete totals; excluded IO is still reported. Setup cannot silently remove a required phase.
5. Run dense and regular schedules at N=300 plus the declared N=1200,V=10000 stress/scaling case, with measured bandwidth and conservative preparation/runtime live-state bounds across all workers. Do not infer N=1200,V=100000 qualification. Keep primitive-array bounds, allocation/GC and whole-process RSS separate.
6. An independent small same-model oracle at decoded off-node shapes must verify outputs/criterion/terminal diagnostics before performance numbers are eligible. This is computational admission only; full scientific recovery/coverage remains PHRF-14. Record warmup and raw complete-cell receipts; PHRF-15 later owns >=5-run distributions and broader scaling.
7. Replace/extend the benchmark runner so it fails or clearly marks the receipt non-admitted on incomplete work, nonfinite results, budget exhaustion or accuracy failure. Update profile-hrf-trial-banded-evidence.md, profile-hrf-cohorts.md and the v2 completion paragraph to distinguish old component timings from the new complete checkpoint. Keep raw logs, environment, exact source/provider revisions and achieved/unmet goals.
8. Close with a measured DECISION, even if the budget fails: passing complete B0 keeps PHRF-10 deferred; a miss requires a documented activation/engineering disposition. If it activates PHRF-10, set it active/P1, promote its required PHRF-30 prerequisite and add blocking edges into qualification/release before closing this decision ticket. An unmet checkpoint is not a passing qualification and PHRF-15/16 cannot close on it. No finite-state implementation is automatically required just because the earlier receipt was incomplete.

Validation: affected benchmark compiles warning-clean, integrated correctness/lifecycle laws pass on JVM and JS, complete JVM B0 receipts exist for the exact measured configuration, and the final dependency graph matches the measured decision.
